???+ remember "Before you start, remember"

    ??? question "In a control-flow graph, what kind of edge makes a loop?"

        A back edge, one that goes back to an earlier block.

        Introduced in [Build v0.1: 7. Functions and control flow](../compiler/guide/stage-7-functions-and-control-flow.md).

    ??? question "What is a straight run of instructions with one way in at the top and one way out at the bottom called?"

        A basic block. Nothing jumps into the middle of it.

        Introduced in [Build v0.1: 7. Functions and control flow](../compiler/guide/stage-7-functions-and-control-flow.md).

    ??? question "Which picture of a function shows basic blocks joined by arrows for where execution can go next?"

        The control-flow graph (CFG).

        Introduced in [Build v0.1: 7. Functions and control flow](../compiler/guide/stage-7-functions-and-control-flow.md).

    ??? question "In SSA form, what picks which version of a value to use at a point where two paths meet?"

        A phi. Its choice depends on which path was taken.

        Introduced in [Build v0.1: 6. The first machine code](../compiler/guide/stage-6-first-machine-code.md).

    ??? question "In which style of IR is every named value assigned exactly once, so that a changing variable becomes a series of versions?"

        Static single assignment (SSA) form.

        Introduced in [Build v0.1: 6. The first machine code](../compiler/guide/stage-6-first-machine-code.md).
